title: Cereal yield in World, 2023: 4,229 kg per hectare
text:
Cereal yield in World, 2023: 4,229 kg per hectare

# Cereal yield in World

Cereal farms in the world harvested 4,229 kg per hectare in 2023. The value for 2023 is the highest in the series, which starts in 1961.

World is a group: All economies covered by the World Bank. The value is the aggregate published by World Bank, not an average calculated on this site.

 World, 2023 4,229 Kilograms per hectare Change from 2022 +1.0% 2022: 4,186 kg per hectare European Union, 2023 5,329 kg per hectare Official aggregate

## In short

- That is a change of +1.0% from 4,186 kg per hectare in 2022.
- Since 2013, when it was 3,830 kg per hectare, the figure has changed by +10.4%.
- The figure for the European Union in 2023 was 5,329 kg per hectare.

## What this measures

Harvested cereal production, including wheat, rice, maize, barley and others, per hectare of harvested land. Crops harvested for hay or green feed are excluded.
